title: Diffusion Model's Generalization Can Be Characterized by Inductive Biases toward a Data-Dependent Ridge Manifold
summary: We study a data-dependent notion of diffusion-model generalization: when a model does not memorize the training set, where do its generated samples go relative to the geometry induced by the data? To answer this, we introduce a time-dependent family of log-density ridge manifolds constructed from the smoothed empirical distribution, and use it to characterize reverse-time inference.
